## Completeness boundary

This report covers only the 71 direct all-of relationships imported from Clause 24.7, Table 10 and their 96 endpoint features. It does not establish minimum conformance, selected-profile conformance, or complete feature taxonomy coverage.

The alternative-choice requirements for GP01, the minimum graph type, GL04–GL10 scalar families, GV45, and GV65 are not implication edges. M01-PR05 owns those rules.
